name: Spain
standard: UNE-EN 301549:2022 (Spanish version of EN 301 549 V3.2.1, WCAG 2.1 AA)

laws.summary: Transposes the WAD for Spanish public sector websites and mobile apps.

applies_to: State, regional and local administrations, public institutions, the Justice Administration and other entities listed in art. 2.

deadlines.what: Mobile apps (3-year transition per the decree; WAD deadline was 2021-06-23)

exceptions: WAD exceptions including third-party content not financed or controlled by the body
requires: Presumption of conformity via harmonised norms (art. 6)
Complaint and communication channels (art. 10), with responses to formal complaints within 20 working days (art. 12)
Accessibility statement updated annually and linked from an 'Accesibilidad' footer on every page (art. 15)
Internal Unidad responsable de accesibilidad in each organisation (art. 16)
mobile: explicit — the title and scope cover mobile applications.
enforcement: Unidades responsables handle complaints internally; the national Observatorio de Accesibilidad Web monitors and reports; reports go to the Commission.
notes: Transition dates are paraphrased from a model summary of the consolidated BOE text, so confirm them against the disposición transitoria. The UNE-EN 301549:2022 status comes from search summaries. The EAA is transposed separately by Ley 11/2023, which was not verified here.
